facts.text: A graphics card is a circuit board carrying a graphics processing unit (GPU) and its memory; the speed of sensor simulation depends heavily on the card used.

facts.text: Most graphics cards named in the booklet are NVIDIA models because the reviewed simulators depend on NVIDIA's ray-tracing libraries.

facts.text: The NVIDIA-specific requirement of Chrono's high-performance modules is flagged as a dependency risk, not a recommendation; the Chrono community itself has raised the requirement.
